title: Discussion forum
goal: Turn the page into a small discussion forum with two views. The front page has a text input with the placeholder "Post title", a button labelled "Submit", and the list of stored posts, each shown as "TITLE [points: N, comments: K]" with a button labelled "Upvote TITLE" and a button labelled "Open TITLE". Posts are listed by points, highest first; posts with equal points keep the order they were submitted. Above the list the front page shows "Top post: TITLE" for the first post in that order, or "Top post: none" when there are no posts. Clicking Submit stores a new post with 0 points and clears the input; clicking Upvote adds one point on the server. Clicking Open replaces the front page with the post view: the post title, its comments in the order they were written, a text input with the placeholder "Comment", a button labelled "Post comment", and a button labelled "Back" that returns to the front page. Posts are stored as `Post` nodes connected to root, with fields `title: str` and `points: int`; each comment is a `Comment` node with a field `text: str`, connected to its post, not to root. Every change is stored on the server and shown when the page loads. You may remove the Ping button.
